snippet.title: WheelMates Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
WheelMates, a 2-player co-op adventure with RC cars, is OUT on Steam! Play together with Friend's Pass  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3905450/WheelMates/

WheelMates is a co-op driving adventure where two players pilot tiny RC cars through the house of an eccentric scientist. Team up to solve puzzles, explore hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside the house.
